newsitem.title: SWEDEN: New Skanska board gives continuity-Barnevi.
newsitem.headline: New Skanska board gives continuity-Barnevi.

text.p: Swedish construction company Skanska's new board, chaired by Melker Schorling, would give the company the continuity which its large projects demand, departing chairman Percy Barnevik said on Monday.
"It is important we get some continuity in Skanska following all the publicity," Barnevik told a news conference.
"I have been in charge of the task of nominating the new board and the current board is unanimous."

Barnevik was critical of recent media speculation about Skanska's new board since his appointment to the chair of Investor, the investment vehicle and lynchpin of Sweden's powerful Wallenberg dynasty.
The Wallenberg have no holding in Skanska.
"It's been never ending speculations about who's not friendly with whom instead of directing focus on substantial questions which will decide the future of Skanska," Barnevik said.
Barnevik said he had never intended to remain as chairman of Skanska for a long time, irrespective of his new position at Investor.
"I have been part of getting Skanska to where it is today. It's been a long process and my intentions were not to stay for more than perhaps another year," Barnevik said.
